verdict.rationale: Muse's own data policy says users can inspect, edit and download all files in their VM, including everything Muse generates on their behalf and its memory about them. That is a documented first-party download path for a substantial part of their data. However, nothing documents exporting chat history or a full account-data archive. The activity log and audit trail are view-only in the evidence. Missing for 10: explicit chat-history export, a complete account-data export (e.g. a takeout-style archive), export format details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
